# Epigram

> Open-source, free, and AI-powered news in short. Epigram delivers bite-sized news summaries, real-time updates, and in-depth analysis from trusted sources, built for busy people.

Epigram simplifies the way you stay informed. With AI, it delivers quick, clear summaries from reliable sources, so you get the news without the overwhelm. For more details, dive into deeper analysis or explore topics you care about — all in a feed tailored to your interests.

## Pages

- [Home](https://epigram.news/): The personalized news feed with AI-powered summaries.
- [About](https://epigram.news/about): What Epigram is and how it works.
- [Topics](https://epigram.news/topics): Browse news by topic.

## Topics

- General: Top headlines from around the world.
- Business: Markets, companies, and the economy.
- Entertainment: Movies, music, and culture.
- Health: Medicine, wellness, and public health.
- Science: Research and discoveries.
- Sports: Scores, teams, and athletes.
- Technology: Gadgets, software, and the tech industry.
